proposed_ci_evidence_emission_step.name: Emit CI Evidence Record
proposed_ci_evidence_emission_step.description: A CI step that constructs a canonical CIEvidenceRecord from the mutation summary and persists it as an uploadable artifact. Fingerprints would be computed via collect_repo_fingerprints(); the snippet below is illustrative of the wiring, not the literal YAML block.
proposed_ci_evidence_emission_step.run_snippet:
python - <<'PY'
import json, os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import UTC, datetime
sha = subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
record = {
  'schema': 'm9-ci-evidence/v1',
  'record_id': f"ci::{os.environ.get('GITHUB_RUN_ID','local')}::{os.environ.get('GITHUB_JOB','mutation')}::mutation",
  'repository_sha': sha,
  'workflow': 'mutation.yml',
  'job': os.environ.get('GITHUB_JOB','mutation'),
  'step': 'Run mutation testing',
  'command': 'python runtime/verify.py mutation',
  'verification_task': 'task::mutation::full',
  'component': os.environ.get('TARGET_ENGINE', None),
  'capability': None,
  'evidence_kind': 'mutation-summary',
  'execution_mode': 'authoritative',
  'source_fingerprint': '',
  'test_fingerprint': '',
  'configuration_fingerprint': '',
  'toolchain_fingerprint': '',
  'population_fingerprint': '',
  'evidence_artifact_fingerprint': '',
  'artifact_path': 'backend/tests/generated/mutation/mutation-summary.json',
  'started_at': datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
  'ended_at': datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
  'exit_status': int(os.environ.get('STEP_EXIT_CODE','0')),
  'failure_classification': None,
  'summary': {}
}
out_dir = Path('runtime/generated/ci-evidence')
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out_file = out_dir / f"ci-evidence-{os.environ.get('GITHUB_RUN_ID','local')}-{os.environ.get('GITHUB_JOB','job')}.json"
out_file.write_text(json.dumps([record], indent=2))
print(f'CI evidence emitted to {out_file}')
PY
